focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞半導體設備、材料、封測、機房電力與終端工廠
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asia semiconductor equipment, materials, test, data-center power and factories

throughline.zh: 工研院的稀土供應規劃、台電颱風後配電復原與東南亞海纜招標分別處於技術開發、實際搶修及跨境基礎設施規劃階段。
throughline.en: ITRI's rare-earth plan, Taipower's typhoon restoration and Southeast Asia's subsea cable tender are at distinct stages of technology development, operational recovery and cross-border infrastructure planning.

text.zh: 工研院提出 2028 年示範廠與 2030 年年產 500 噸稀土目標，預算與廠址尚未核定。
text.en: ITRI targets an end-2028 rare-earth demonstration plant and 500 tonnes per year by 2030, without approved funding or a site.

text.zh: 台電 10 月 24 日下午通報全台逾 34 萬戶曾停電、復電率逾 9 成，未揭露半導體產線停工數據。
text.en: Taipower reported more than 340,000 accounts affected and over 90% restored on Oct 24, without fab shutdown data.

text.zh: MViSTA 海纜預計串聯馬、越、星、泰四國，估計 4 億美元，供應商仍未決標。
text.en: MViSTA's proposed four-country cable has an estimated US$400M budget; supplier selection is pending.

text.zh: 玉晶光 9 月自結歸母淨利 4.34 億元，媒體報導 3M 私募款項已匯入，EBO 與 CPO 量產仍未確認。
text.en: GSEO reported NT$434M in September net profit and 3M placement proceeds reportedly arrived; EBO and CPO production remains unconfirmed.

text.zh: 駐菲代表提及台菲半導體經濟走廊合作及菲律賓 2030 年 1,100 億美元出口目標，尚無新建廠案。
text.en: Taiwan's envoy discussed Philippine semiconductor corridors and its US$110B 2030 export goal, without new fab approvals.

title.zh: 工研院規劃稀土示範廠，2030 年產 500 噸及滿足半數需求為目標
title.en: ITRI plans rare-earth pilot-to-demo plant, targets 500 tonnes a year by 2030

summary.zh: 工研院院長張培仁 10 月 24 日向中央社表示，現有稀土實驗線年產約 5,000 公斤，計畫 2028 年底在工業區完成示範工廠，並在 2030 年底前達年產 500 噸及滿足台灣約 50% 需求的目標。示範工廠尚待國科會編列預算，廠址與商業營運安排尚未確定。
summary.en: ITRI president Chang Pei-jen told CNA on October 24 that its existing rare-earth pilot line has a capacity of about 5,000 kg a year. ITRI aims to complete an industrial-park demonstration plant by end-2028 and reach 500 tonnes annually, representing roughly half of Taiwan's demand, by end-2030; funding, site selection and the commercial model are not finalized.

text.zh: 稀土分離、金屬製造與高階磁鐵製程可連結工廠自動化馬達、精密設備驅動與半導體製造機台零組件。工研院指出，現有工作涉及中興院區的分離與金屬技術，以及六甲院區的磁鐵設備；材料精製與磁鐵成品不能用同一產能直接替代計算。
text.en: Rare-earth separation, metallurgy and high-performance magnets are relevant to automation motors, precision drive systems and semiconductor equipment components. ITRI described separation and metal processes at its Zhongxing campus and magnet-making equipment at Liujia. Intermediate materials and finished magnets are not interchangeable output measures.

text.zh: 工研院透露示範工廠將選址工業區，以利未來技術移轉，但仍須國科會支持建廠預算，價格保障與商業合作模式也在討論。10 月 22 日媒體所稱台積電評估稀土替代馬達屬另一項來源受限報導，不代表工研院產能已有晶圓廠客戶認證。
text.en: ITRI is considering an industrial-park site to facilitate technology transfer, while National Science and Technology Council budget authorization and possible price-support arrangements remain under discussion. Separate October 22 reporting on alternative fab motors does not establish that ITRI's future output has qualified semiconductor customers.

text.zh: 示範廠的城市、地號、核定經費、產線良率、稀土元素組合與實際量產時點未公布；500 噸與 50% 為 2030 年目標。
text.en: The demo site's city and address, approved funding, yields, element mix and actual production timing are undisclosed; 500 tonnes and 50% are targets for 2030.

ceoView.en: Precision-power, motor-drive and controls suppliers would need magnet grades, positioning-motor qualification methods and tool-level specifications. Funding, yields and certifications are unresolved, so supply implications cannot yet be quantified.

title.zh: 薔琵颱風造成全台逾 34 萬戶曾停電，台電 10 月 24 日下午稱復電率逾 9 成
title.en: Taipower reports over 340,000 storm-affected accounts and more than 90% restored

summary.zh: 台電 10 月 24 日下午 3 時公布，薔琵颱風造成全台累計逾 34 萬戶曾停電，當時已復電近 31 萬戶、復電率逾 9 成，並動員逾 1.5 萬人次搶修。雲林區處同日下午 2 時指出強風挾帶鹽塵導致礙子閃絡、部分線路反覆跳脫；上述屬電網供電事故統計，未公布半導體或工廠停線損失。
summary.en: Taipower reported at 3 p.m. on October 24 that more than 340,000 customer accounts had experienced typhoon-related outages, nearly 310,000 had been restored and restoration exceeded 90%, with over 15,000 worker-shifts deployed. Its Yunlin branch cited salt contamination and repeated insulator flashovers, but no fab or industrial production-loss figures were reported.

text.zh: 颱風供電事件涉及架空線路、配電礙子、變壓器及緊急備援系統，也與高可靠度工廠電力和資料中心設施的電力品質相關。台電表示優先恢復主幹線、分歧線及重要民生設施，累計受影響戶數並不等於單一時點同時停電戶數。
text.en: Storm restoration covers distribution circuits, insulators, transformers and backup infrastructure, all relevant to power reliability in factories and data centers. Taipower prioritizes transmission and feeder recovery; cumulative affected accounts are not simultaneous outages at one time.

text.zh: 中央社 10 月 24 日報導，下午 3 時主要尚待復電區域為新北約 1.2 萬戶、桃園約 7,000 戶、宜蘭約 6,000 戶。台電雲林區處下午 2 時稱縣內累計逾 3.4 萬戶停電，剩約 1,800 戶未復電，沿海鹽塵降低絕緣效能並增加清洗礙子的工序。
text.en: CNA reported that as of 3 p.m. about 12,000 accounts in New Taipei, 7,000 in Taoyuan and 6,000 in Yilan remained without power. Taipower's Yunlin branch said over 34,000 accounts had been affected locally and roughly 1,800 remained out at 2 p.m.; coastal salt and dust reduced insulation performance and prolonged line washing and repairs.

text.zh: 全台最終停電戶數、全面復電時間、個別晶圓廠或設備產線的實際供電與生產損失未公布。
text.en: Final national outage totals, restoration time and actual fab, tool or factory production losses are not available.

title.zh: MViSTA 海纜開發商稱將於 10 月決標，規劃串聯東南亞四國與越南資料中心
title.en: MViSTA developer targets October cable supplier selection across four Southeast Asian countries

summary.zh: Reuters 10 月 22 日引述越南 Stavian 旗下 MViSTA 開發主管表示，連接馬來西亞、越南、新加坡及泰國的 16 對光纖海底電纜，預估長 2,500 公里、成本約 4 億美元，將在日本 NEC 與法國 Alcatel Submarine Networks 間選擇供應商，目標 2028 年底啟用。工程尚未決標，越南資料中心園區也仍處可行性研究階段。
summary.en: Reuters reported October 22 that an executive at Vietnamese project developer Stavian expects the 16-fiber-pair MViSTA subsea cable connecting Malaysia, Vietnam, Singapore and Thailand to select a supplier from Japan's NEC and France's Alcatel Submarine Networks in October. The proposed 2,500-km, approximately US$400 million cable targets late-2028 service, while the linked Vietnam data center remains at feasibility-study stage.

text.zh: 海纜可提供跨國資料中心及雲端流量互連；相關股東含越南 Stavian、日本 Midas Capital 與馬來西亞 OMS Group 子公司 LitUp Network，後者預定負責鋪設工程。海纜容量、陸上機房電力、光纖上線及雲端承租並非相同進度。
text.en: Subsea connectivity links regional cloud and data-center traffic. Reported stakeholders include Vietnam's Stavian, Japan's Midas Capital and Malaysia's LitUp Network, an OMS Group subsidiary intended to lay the cable. Cable construction, power infrastructure and hyperscale tenancy have different development schedules.

text.zh: Reuters 引述開發商稱仍待招標定案；USTDA 於 9 月 23 日公告，資助越南胡志明市 Stavian Digital Park 的供電、散熱與連接設施可行性研究，該研究並不等於園區已取得建廠融資。開發商對供應商排除條件的早期發言之後已澄清為個人看法，不應作為採購禁令。
text.en: Reuters described an ongoing supplier tender. A September 23 USTDA announcement separately confirms funding for a feasibility study of power, cooling and connectivity at Stavian Digital Park in Ho Chi Minh City; that does not establish construction financing. An early executive comment about excluding certain suppliers was later clarified as a personal view, not a formal purchasing rule.

text.zh: 未公布最終海纜供應商、確定合約價格、路線許可、登陸站、測試容量與越南資料中心最終投資額；4 億美元及 2028 年底均為預估。
text.en: Final cable supplier, contract value, routing permits, landing stations, tested capacity and the Vietnam data-center funding are unconfirmed; US$400 million and late 2028 remain estimates.

title.zh: 玉晶光公告 9 月自結淨利 4.34 億元，3M 私募股款已匯入
title.en: GSEO reports NT$434M September net profit as 3M placement proceeds arrive

summary.zh: 玉晶光 10 月 23 日公告自結 9 月歸屬母公司淨利約新台幣 4.34 億元，年減 15%，每股盈餘 3.85 元；同日媒體報導 3M 認購私募股款約 48.13 億元已匯入。雙方先前公布合作研發擴束光學（EBO）、共封裝光學與資料中心互連產品，但尚未公布量產客戶驗收或出貨量；股款入帳不等於新產品量產。
summary.en: Genius Electronic Optical reported October 23 self-compiled September profit attributable to owners of about NT$434 million, down 15% year on year, and EPS of NT$3.85. Separate reporting said 3M's roughly NT$4.813 billion private-placement payment had arrived. Earlier cooperation covers Expanded Beam Optical, co-packaged optics and data-center interconnects, without a confirmed customer production ramp.

text.zh: 玉晶光現有精密光學製造能力將支援 3M 的 EBO 光連接套管及光互連模組研製，供應鏈涉及精密材料、光學零組件、先進封裝與資料中心交換連接。自結損益反映既有業務，無法單獨歸因於尚未量產的光學互連合作。
text.en: GSEO's precision optics production is intended to support 3M's EBO ferrules and optical interconnect development. This links precision optical materials, advanced packaging and data-center networking, while September financial performance cannot be attributed to products not yet in volume production.

text.zh: 3M 10 月 19 日第一手公告稱擬取得玉晶光約 4.7% 股權，原計畫須完成慣例交割條件；10 月 23 日媒體說股款已匯入。玉晶光第三季營收約 78.12 億元、年增約 1%，歸屬母公司淨利約 10.92 億元、年減 23%，依中央社當日報導口徑，季度數字與單月不同。
text.en: 3M's October 19 release said it expected to acquire approximately 4.7% of GSEO subject to customary closing conditions, while October 23 reporting said funds were remitted. CNA reported Q3 revenue around NT$7.812 billion, up about 1%, and parent-attributable net profit around NT$1.092 billion, down about 23%, which are separate quarterly figures.

text.zh: 私募法律程序最終交割日、EBO 製造良率、客戶認證和出貨排程尚未完全披露；9 月及第三季損益屬公司自結。
text.en: Final legal closing, EBO manufacturing yields, customer qualification and shipment schedules remain undisclosed; reported profits are self-compiled.

title.zh: 駐菲代表於台灣連結展談台菲半導體合作，菲國 2030 年出口目標 1,100 億美元
title.en: Taiwan envoy discusses Philippines semiconductor corridors and US$110B 2030 export target

summary.zh: 台灣駐菲代表 10 月 24 日在菲律賓馬卡蒂市台灣連結展致詞表示，可結合台菲經濟走廊與呂宋經濟走廊發展半導體合作。他引述菲律賓希望 2030 年半導體與電子產品年出口達 1,100 億美元的目標，另稱截至 2025 年底登記於 PEZA 的台資超過 450 億披索；目前並未公布新的晶圓廠或封測專案核准案。
summary.en: At the TaiwanLink Fair in Makati on October 24, Taiwan's envoy discussed linking the Taiwan-Philippines and Luzon economic corridors for semiconductor cooperation. He cited the Philippines' goal of US$110 billion in annual electronics and semiconductor exports by 2030 and more than PHP45 billion of registered Taiwanese PEZA investment through end-2025; no new fab or assembly/test project approval was announced.

text.zh: 菲律賓現有電子組裝、測試及產業園區基礎，與台灣晶片設計、晶圓製造及設備供應鏈有互補可能。經濟走廊與技術合作在演講中仍屬政策方向，不能作為資本支出或建廠承諾。
text.en: The Philippines has electronics assembly, testing and industrial-park capacity, while Taiwan has chip design, wafer fabrication and equipment strengths. Economic-corridor linkages remain proposals in a speech, not finalized capex or facility approvals.

text.zh: 中央社報導駐菲代表引用截至 2025 年 12 月台企在 PEZA 登記投資超過 450 億披索、創造逾 2 萬個直接就業機會，以及 2026 年前 8 個月雙邊貿易超過 70 億美元。上述歷史統計應與 10 月 24 日的新政策合作表述分開。
text.en: The envoy cited historical PEZA registrations exceeding PHP45 billion and more than 20,000 direct jobs through December 2025, plus bilateral trade exceeding US$7 billion in the first eight months of 2026. These are dated reference figures, distinct from the October 24 cooperation remarks.

text.zh: 尚未公布新台菲半導體製造合約、經濟走廊共同施工計畫、合作廠商名單與承諾資本額。
text.en: No new Taiwan-Philippines semiconductor manufacturing contract, shared corridor construction plan, named manufacturer or committed project capital was disclosed.

title.zh: 中華電信成立中華曜智科技，整合 Edge AI 影像辨識與智慧安防
title.en: Chunghwa Telecom launches intelligent vision subsidiary for edge AI systems

summary.zh: 中華電信 10 月 22 日宣布成立中華曜智科技股份有限公司，將原有智慧影像、影像辨識與智慧安防技術整合為新公司，服務政府、企業及智慧城市。公司提及 Edge AI 與視覺應用，但沒有公布新廠、硬體設備訂單、營收基期或建置量。
summary.en: Chunghwa Telecom announced October 22 the establishment of CHT Intelligent Vision Solutions, consolidating its video analytics, image recognition and smart-security capabilities for enterprise and public-sector use. The announcement covers edge AI applications but gives no factory capital spending, hardware orders or deployment volumes.

text.zh: 邊緣影像辨識應用可使用工業電腦、視覺感測器、網路設備與伺服器平台，部分解決方案適用工廠安防與設施監控。公告沒有提供在半導體廠、資料中心或自動化產線已交付的實例及客戶驗收數據。
text.en: Edge video analytics may involve industrial PCs, imaging sensors, networking and servers, with applications in facility security and industrial monitoring. The release does not identify delivered deployments or acceptance metrics for fabs, data centers or automated factories.

text.zh: 官方指出新公司由中華電信既有研發團隊和技術延伸，將聚焦智慧安防、辨識與影像分析，並整合雲網及資安能力。此舉為公司組織與產品路線公告，而非建置完成的新增算力。
text.en: The company says its new subsidiary builds on existing R&D capabilities, integrating intelligent surveillance and computer-vision services with cloud, network and security platforms. The disclosure is an organizational and product-direction update, not installed compute capacity.

text.zh: 新公司實收資本、量產硬體規格、客戶採購數量、影像辨識準確率及工業客戶導入實績未公布。
text.en: Paid-in capital, production hardware specifications, customer volumes, measured accuracy and industrial customer acceptance remain undisclosed.

question.zh: 工研院 500 噸目標與現有稀土實驗線如何區分？
question.en: How does ITRI's 500-tonne goal differ from its pilot line?

text.zh: 工研院現有實驗線約年產 5,000 公斤，2028 年示範廠、2030 年年產 500 噸仍待預算及工程確認，元素組合與成品磁材規格也未公布。
text.en: The existing line reportedly produces about 5,000 kg annually, while the 2028 plant and 500-tonne 2030 target depend on funding and implementation; element grades remain unspecified.

question.zh: 全台 34 萬戶停電與工廠停線可以畫上等號嗎？
question.en: Does 340,000 affected power accounts imply fab downtime?

text.zh: 台電數字是累計曾停電戶數，並非同時停電量；需另外取得各廠區電力品質、UPS 切換、實際停機及良率紀錄，才能討論生產影響。
text.en: Taipower counted cumulative affected accounts, not simultaneous outages. Site power-quality, backup transfers and actual tool records would be needed to establish manufacturing effects.

question.zh: 海纜 4 億美元預估與越南機房可行性研究是否屬同一投資？
question.en: Is the US$400M cable estimate the same as the Vietnam data-center project?

text.zh: MViSTA 為海纜規劃成本與供應商招標，USTDA 資助的是胡志明市資料中心園區可行性研究；兩案尚未公開可相加的核定資本支出。
text.en: MViSTA's US$400M is a cable cost estimate and tender; USTDA funds a feasibility study for a separate Ho Chi Minh City campus, not an approved project capex total.

text.zh: 提前發布日期為 2026 年 10 月 25 日，內容以 10 月 24 日晚間前可取得的公開聲明為準，尚未包含 25 日後續變化。
text.en: This early October 25 edition uses disclosures available through late October 24, before any October 25 follow-up changes.

verificationNote.zh: 工研院稀土示範廠為未核定計畫，年產能和自給率為 2030 年目標；颱風供電數字為 10 月 24 日下午特定時間點，未取得工廠停線資料；海纜成本與時程為開發商估計，供應商尚未決標；玉晶光自結損益未經正式查核，光學互連量產仍待驗證；菲律賓 2030 年出口數字為政策目標。 稀土產能與菲國政策目標未直接取得原始官方公告，按受訪者經媒體轉述列出；主要數值已標示來源限制。
verificationNote.en: ITRI's rare-earth site, output and self-sufficiency figures remain unapproved targets. Storm outage figures are October 24 afternoon snapshots without site-level production losses. MViSTA's cost and schedule are developer estimates with no supplier awarded. GSEO's earnings are self-reported and interconnect production unqualified; the Philippines' 2030 export figure is a policy target. The ITRI and Philippines targets were reported from interviews rather than independently available original official notices; material claims retain source limitations.
